# ESLint Baseline Post-Wave-1 Specification

## Purpose

The `eslint-baseline-post-wave-1.json` file captures the ESLint state after completing the first wave of automated fixes. It serves as:

- Evidence of wave 1 completion
- Starting point for wave 2 analysis
- Comparison point for delta calculations

## Generation

Generated by running ESLint after wave 1 fixes were applied:

```bash
# After applying --fix and committing changes
npx eslint . --format json > .github/reports/linting/eslint-baseline-post-wave-1.json
```

## Schema

This file follows the same schema as `eslint-baseline.json` - the standard ESLint JSON output format.

### Top-Level Structure

Array of file results with messages, error counts, and source code.

See [eslint-baseline.spec.md](./eslint-baseline.spec.md) for full schema documentation.

## Key Differences from Original Baseline

| Metric              | Original | Post-Wave-1 | Improvement |
| ------------------- | -------- | ----------- | ----------- |
| Total Errors        | 3,610    | ~1,300      | ~64%        |
| `prettier/prettier` | 2,310    | 1           | 99.96%      |
| `no-unused-vars`    | 32       | 28          | 12.5%       |
| File Size           | 1.3MB    | 736KB       | 43%         |

## Usage

### Delta Analysis

```javascript
const before = require("./eslint-baseline.json");
const after = require("./eslint-baseline-post-wave-1.json");

const beforeTotal = before.reduce((sum, f) => sum + f.errorCount, 0);
const afterTotal = after.reduce((sum, f) => sum + f.errorCount, 0);

console.log(`Wave 1 fixed ${beforeTotal - afterTotal} issues`);
```

### Planning Wave 2

```javascript
// Identify remaining issues
const remaining = after
  .filter((f) => f.errorCount > 0)
  .flatMap((f) => f.messages.map((m) => m.ruleId))
  .reduce((acc, rule) => {
    acc[rule] = (acc[rule] || 0) + 1;
    return acc;
  }, {});

console.log("Remaining issues by rule:", remaining);
```

## Notes

- This baseline captures the state immediately after wave 1 auto-fixes
- Remaining issues are primarily `no-undef` which requires manual review
- Use `wave-1-delta.json` for quick comparison statistics
